# BuildEntityMode

What a build did with one definition.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Created"` | The definition is new. |
| `"Updated"` | The definition changed: a versioned one has a new version. |
| `"Unchanged"` | The definition is the same as what is already deployed. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.
